descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Make use of two types of supernatural bullets to face off against scary vegetables!
The catharsis of annihilation is only for those who fight to the end!

Beware of the terrifying vegetables that will spawn and approach you.
Eliminate them without getting too close.

[media]

Are you ready to encounter the mightiest black vegetables as you advance through the game?
Get ready for an exciting challenge!

# Terrifying vegetables await you.
[media]

# You and the vegetables will grow stronger and stronger.
[media]
